content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Short-term home rental marketplace for travelers and hosts; no consumer money transfer or remittance business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Carrier billing for digital goods sold to merchants; no person-to-person cross-border money transfer."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Billboards, rural broadband and insurance brokerage; no money transfer or remittance activity."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"B2B freight and utility bill payment for corporate clients; not consumer remittances to family abroad."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Purchases and collects charged-off consumer debt; no sending of money for customers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Online marketplace for independent sellers and buyers of goods; different business model."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Freight forwarding and customs brokerage for importers and exporters; goods logistics, not money transfer."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Truckload and intermodal freight transportation for shippers; physical goods logistics."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Less-than-truckload freight trucking for business shippers; no financial transfer services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Merchant card processing and B2B payables software for businesses; not consumer cross-border transfers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Merchant payment processing and bill payment for vertical businesses and government; not remittances."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Commercial and personal insurance brokerage through carriers; no money transmission business."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Cash-in-transit, ATM services and security for banks and retailers; B2B cash logistics, not consumer remittances."}]}
